blocks.text: Sample content for UI development. Read the whole lease before signing, and get a translated copy if it is not in a language you read well.

items: Confirm the deposit, monthly rent, and maintenance fee amounts.
Check the contract length and what happens if you leave early.
Ask who pays for repairs and which utilities are included.
Take dated photos of the unit before you move in.

blocks.text: Never pay a deposit before you have seen the signed contract.
